info.title: Beat Stackz API
info.description: Generated from shared/src/api/*. Do not edit by hand.

get.summary: Current user + their personal vault id
Vaults the caller is a member of

post.summary: Create a shared vault; caller becomes owner
Add an existing user by email (owner only). 404 if no such user.

delete.summary: Remove member (owner, or self). 409 if last owner.

post.summary: Create folder. 409 on name collision in parent.

patch.summary: Rename and/or move. 409 on collision or stale ifUpdatedAt.

post.summary: Clear deletedAt on the folder and the descendants trashed with it (same deletedAt). 404 if not in trash; 409 if the parent is still trashed or a live sibling has the same name.

patch.summary: Rename / move. 409 on collision or stale.

get.summary: List trashed folders and files (top level), newest first

post.summary: Clear deletedAt. 404 if not in trash; 409 if the parent folder is still trashed or a live sibling has the same name.

get.summary: Presigned GET URL, 5 min. 409 conflict until status is ready.
Precomputed peaks. 409 conflict until status is ready; 404 if not audio.

post.summary: Begin multipart upload (membership check happens here)
Finish upload; returns the file row
Create share; link token returned once in url

get.summary: Resolve a share link (404 if revoked or expired)
